result:
Done! ✓ The operations dashboard is built and compiles successfully.

**What I shipped:**

- **Dashboard component** (`dashboard.ts`) — the main screen with full template wired to ViewModel
- **DashboardViewModel** (`dashboard.view-model.ts`) — holds all state and logic as signals: hero count, top heroes (sorted by power), stat counts, average power
- **StatTile component** (`src/app/ui/stat-tile.component.ts`) — presentational card showing metric, icon, value, and optional trend
- **HeroCard component** (`src/app/ui/hero-card.component.ts`) — hero portrait card with name, alias, power class badge, power meter bar, status pill
- **PowerMeter component** (`src/app/ui/power-meter.component.ts`) — reusable power visualization (ready for use in hero detail)
- **Theme palette** — applied light and dark mode colors to `styles.css` per the spec (cool indigo-biased neutrals, amber-gold action, dark sidebar)

**Layout per spec:**
- Page header: "Operations Dashboard" title + "+ Recruit" button
- Stat tiles row: Heroes / Missions Live / Average Power / Active Threats (grid, 4 cols at desktop, 2 at tablet, 1 at mobile)
- "Top heroes this cycle" section with card grid (4 cards at desktop, responsive down to 1 at mobile) + "View all roster" link
- "Roster" section heading with count (the roster table comes in the next stage)

**Architecture:**
- MVVM: ViewModel is component-scoped, no direct service injection in components, all state is signals
- No `.subscribe()` in the component template — using signals throughout
- Presentational UI components under `src/app/ui/` take `input()` only, no service injection
- Icons via `<ng-icon>` with lucide, zero inline SVG
- All spartan primitives used (hlm-card, hlm-badge, hlm-avatar, hlm-button)
- Responsive layout: grid for regions, flex for runs, gap for spacing, design tokens for colors

**Build result:** Clean compile, zero errors. Bundle size is 571KB (exceeds 500KB budget guideline but not a blocker).
